description: This file defines a Gantt chart drawing class for project management visualization, using external libraries for date handling and chart rendering, and includes a main block demonstrating its usage.

classes.name: GanttCanvas
classes.description: A class for creating and drawing Gantt charts, managing data, colors, and rendering the chart to a PDF file.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the GanttCanvas with output file, conversion functions, and sets up internal data structures.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a set of tasks with associated user and name to the Gantt chart data.

methods.name: draw
methods.description: Renders the Gantt chart to the canvas, including axes, grid, and task bars.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the canvas, finalizing the PDF output.
